title: get_configuration input
description: What rules are in force, row by row, and what changed between two versions. Writes nothing.

entity.description: Only this entity, by its entity key, such as tier or gate-policy.

keys.description: Only rows with these keys. A child row key is the parent key, a slash, then the child key.

version.description: This version. Leave out for the version in force.

compareToVersion.description: Also return the diff from this version to the one read.
